en.title: Maximum Strings Buildable from at Most K Letters
en.description:
Choose at most K letters from a–j (chosen letters can be reused); find the maximum number of the given strings that can be built completely.

This site's standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains n K (1≤n≤100000, 0≤K≤10); each of the next n lines is a non-empty lowercase string containing only a–j. The total length is ≤200000 (site supplement).
en.output: Output the maximum number of strings that can be built.
en.explanation: Compress each string into a bitmask of its letter set, then enumerate the sets of at most K letters and count.
hints: Compress each string into a bitmask of its letter set, then enumerate the sets of at most K letters and count.
